verdict.rationale: Abandoned-cart recovery is a fair axis for a commerce platform like Medusa, but the evidence pack never documents a feature that detects abandoned carts or checkouts and sends recovery emails or links. The Cart Module page title, webhook events, and background workers are at most developer building blocks for constructing such a flow, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a merchant, abandoned carts and checkouts trigger recovery emails or links so I can win the sale back
